# ChessScout.net

> AI-powered chess coaching that finds the mistakes you keep making across all your games, not just one game at a time.

ChessScout imports your games from Chess.com or Lichess and finds recurring patterns — the same blunder type, the same weak opening, the same time-trouble collapse — showing up across many games, not just a single-game review.

## Pricing

- Free: unlimited daily puzzles, 3 opponent scouts, 5 personalized courses, unlimited practice bots, first 20 games imported
- Pro: $5/month or $55/year — unlimited everything, full cross-game pattern analysis
- No free trial, no credit card required for the free tier, cancel anytime

## Key features

- Cross-game pattern analysis: finds recurring mistakes across your whole game history, not just one game
- Scan Position: photograph any chess position (your game, a book, a stream) and practice it out from that exact position — no other chess tool offers this
- Practice Bots: 8 bot opponents from 400–2000 ELO with live move-quality feedback
- Opponent Scout: prepare for a specific opponent before you play them
- Personalized Courses: lessons built from your own recurring mistakes, not generic theory
- Daily Puzzles: filterable by type (mate in 1/2/3, forks, pins, skewers, endgames)
